{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=16|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Apple Inc.]] and [[Google]] [[Internet censorship in India|remove]] [[TikTok]] from their app stores in [[India]] after a high court in [[Madras]] ruled the app could expose children to sexual content and cyberbullying. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/17/tech/tiktok-ban-india/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Starbucks]] opens its first store in [[Belgrade]], the capital of [[Serbia]].
;International relations
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]], [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]], [[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] vetoes a Congressional resolution that sought to end U.S. support for [[Saudi Arabia]]'s military intervention in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-saudi-yemen/trump-vetoes-congressional-resolution-to-end-u-s-involvement-in-yemen-war-idUSKCN1RS2GH (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Five people are killed and 13 others injured in an arson and stabbing attack in an apartment complex in [[Jinju]], [[South Korea]]. The attacker tells the police he was angry because of back pay. [http://m.koreatimes.co.kr/pages/article.asp?newsIdx=267295 (''The Korea Times'')]
*Eight families file a lawsuit against [[Washington Hebrew Congregation]] for allowing what they say was a lack of action over an assistant teacher who stands accused of sexually abusing several children in the day care program. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/04/16/washington-d-c-jewish-preschool-accused-enabling-sexual-abuse-lawsuit/3456753002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/16/us/synagogue-lawsuit-abuse/index.html (CNN)]
